name: articulation_points_bridges
author: f6f61ae0
description: Finds articulation points and bridges: vertices or edges whose removal increases the number of connected components. Use to identify single points of failure in an undirected network. Supports weighted and unweighted undirected graphs, ignoring weights; rejects directed graphs. Returns sorted node and edge references, full counts and a truncation flag, with up to top_k entries per list.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum entries per result list; byte limit may reduce this further.
